Full huge phylogenetic tree
```{r}
# Start with a clean slate
rm(list = ls())

# GTDB-Tk phylogenetic placement figure
library(ape)
library(ggtree)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(stringr)
library(readxl)

# Read GTDB-Tk outputs
tree <- read.tree(
  "D:/Planktothrix_microbiomes/gtdb_output_bestMAGsonly/65MAGs/classify/gtdbtk.backbone.bac120.classify.tree"
)

gtdb <- read.delim(
  "D:/Planktothrix_microbiomes/gtdb_output_bestMAGsonly/65MAGs/gtdbtk.bac120.summary.tsv",
  sep = "\t",
  header = TRUE,
  check.names = FALSE
)


# Extract taxonomy from GTDB classification
taxonomy <- gtdb %>%
  select(user_genome, classification) %>%
  separate(
    classification,
    into = c(
      "domain",
      "phylum",
      "class",
      "order",
      "family",
      "genus",
      "species"
    ),
    sep = ";",
    fill = "right"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    domain  = str_remove(domain,  "^d__"),
    phylum  = str_remove(phylum,  "^p__"),
    class   = str_remove(class,   "^c__"),
    order   = str_remove(order,   "^o__"),
    family  = str_remove(family,  "^f__"),
    genus   = str_remove(genus,   "^g__"),
    species = str_remove(species, "^s__")
  )

# Use ORIGINAL GTDB names to match to the GTDB tree
mag_ids <- taxonomy$user_genome

# Verify that all MAGs occur in the GTDB placement tree
sum(mag_ids %in% tree$tip.label)
length(mag_ids)

setdiff(mag_ids, tree$tip.label)


# Create annotation dataframe for every tree tip
tip_data <- data.frame(
  label = tree$tip.label,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
) %>%
  left_join(
    taxonomy,
    by = c("label" = "user_genome")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    genome_type = if_else(
      label %in% mag_ids,
      "MAG",
      "GTDB reference"
    )
  )

# Plot the full GTDB backbone
p <- ggtree(
  tree,
  layout = "circular",
  linewidth = 0.15
) %<+% tip_data +
  geom_tippoint(
    data = function(x) dplyr::filter(x, label %in% mag_ids),
    aes(color = phylum),
    size = 1.6
  ) +
scale_color_manual(
  name = "Phylum",
  values = c(
    "Actinomycetota"  = "#7c6f64",
    "Bacteroidota"    = "#5b7694",
    "Cyanobacteriota" = "#52796f",
    "Pseudomonadota"  = "#b45f5a",
    "Chloroflexota"   = "#C49A56"
  )
  ) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "right"
  )

p


```


Prune tree
```{r}
# PRUNE TREE TO MAGs AND RENAME TIPS FOR FIGURE / iTOL

# Keep only our MAGs using ORIGINAL GTDB names
mag_tree <- keep.tip(tree, mag_ids)

# Check that the pruned tree contains all 48 MAGs
Ntip(mag_tree)

# Create annotation dataframe that matches the SHORTENED tree labels
mag_tip_data <- taxonomy %>%
  transmute(
    label = user_genome,
    user_genome,
    domain,
    phylum,
    class,
    order,
    family,
    genus,
    species
  )


# Plot circular MAG-only tree
p_mag <- ggtree(
  mag_tree,
  layout = "circular",
  linewidth = 0.4
) %<+% mag_tip_data +
  geom_tippoint(
    aes(color = phylum),
    size = 1.8
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "Actinomycetota"   = "#7c6f64",
      "Bacteroidota"     = "#5b7694",
      "Cyanobacteriota"  = "#52796f",
      "Pseudomonadota"   = "#b45f5a",
  "Chloroflexota"   = "#C49A56" 
    )
  ) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "right"
  )

p_mag

# Plot rectangular MAG-only tree
p_mag_rect <- ggtree(
  mag_tree,
  layout = "rectangular",
  linewidth = 0.4
) %<+% mag_tip_data +
  geom_tippoint(
    aes(color = phylum),
    size = 1.5
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "Actinomycetota"   = "#7c6f64",
      "Bacteroidota"     = "#5b7694",
      "Cyanobacteriota"  = "#52796f",
      "Pseudomonadota"   = "#b45f5a",
  "Chloroflexota"   = "#C49A56"
    )
  ) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "right"
  )

p_mag_rect

```




Exorts for iTOL
```{r}

# Export the MAG-only tree for iTOL
# THIS FILE WILL CONTAIN THE SHORTENED TIP NAMES
write.tree(
  mag_tree,
  file = "D:/Planktothrix_microbiomes/manuscript_figures/phylo_tree/MAG_65_GTDB_placement.tree"
)

# Create iTOL phylum annotation file

# Choose colors for each phylum
phylum_colors <- c(
  "Actinomycetota"   = "#7c6f64",
      "Bacteroidota"     = "#5b7694",
      "Cyanobacteriota"  = "#52796f",
      "Pseudomonadota"   = "#b45f5a",
  "Chloroflexota"   = "#C49A56"
)

# Build annotation table using SHORT tree names
itol_phylum <- taxonomy %>%
  select(user_genome, phylum) %>%
  mutate(
    color = unname(phylum_colors[phylum])
  )

# Check that every MAG received a color
itol_phylum %>%
  filter(is.na(color))

# Should return 0 rows

# Write iTOL DATASET_COLORSTRIP file
phylum_file <- "D:/Planktothrix_microbiomes/manuscript_figures/phylo_tree/iTOL_phylum_colorstrip_65.txt"

cat(
  "DATASET_COLORSTRIP\n",
  "SEPARATOR TAB\n",
  "DATASET_LABEL\tPhylum\n",
  "COLOR\t#000000\n",
  "STRIP_WIDTH\t25\n",
  "MARGIN\t5\n",
  "BORDER_WIDTH\t0\n",
  "SHOW_INTERNAL\t0\n",
  "DATA\n",
  sep = "",
  file = phylum_file
)

write.table(
  itol_phylum %>%
    transmute(
      ID = user_genome,
      COLOR = color,
      LABEL = phylum
    ),
  file = phylum_file,
  sep = "\t",
  quote = FALSE,
  row.names = FALSE,
  col.names = FALSE,
  append = TRUE
)


# CREATE iTOL DISPLAY LABELS:
# Genus + MAG ID

label_file <- paste0(
  "D:/Planktothrix_microbiomes/manuscript_figures/",
  "phylo_tree/iTOL_MAG_labels_65.txt"
)

# Create labels
itol_labels <- taxonomy %>%
  transmute(
    ID = user_genome,
    DISPLAY_LABEL = ifelse(
      is.na(genus) | genus == "",
      paste0("Unassigned | ", user_genome),
      paste0(genus, " | ", user_genome)
    )
  )

# Inspect before exporting
print(itol_labels)

# Write iTOL LABELS file
cat(
  "LABELS\n",
  "SEPARATOR TAB\n",
  "DATA\n",
  sep = "",
  file = label_file
)

write.table(
  itol_labels,
  file = label_file,
  sep = "\t",
  quote = FALSE,
  row.names = FALSE,
  col.names = FALSE,
  append = TRUE
)


```
